about: The starter shelf: open-source tools, libraries and Claude Code skills that fit common project types. Each entry was checked (repo exists, license, install line) on 2026-11-07. Game skills from github.com/gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills (Apache-2.0). 'for' matches project types: game, site, app, tool, notes, any. 'studio' entries are creative apps people use beside TribeCode (linked, never bundled); ArtCraft checked 2026-11-09.

items.title: ArtCraft
items.summary: The IDE for artists: compose in 2D, stage scenes in 3D, pose characters and pick your image and video models. Make the art, backgrounds and trailers for what the tribe builds, then drop them into Files or the inspiration board.

items.title: Godot Engine
items.summary: A free game engine for 2D and 3D games. Export to the web so the tribe can play it in TribeCode's preview.

items.title: Pixelorama
items.summary: A pixel art editor for sprites, tiles and animations (desktop and web); export sprite sheets the game uses directly.

items.title: Material Maker
items.summary: Make textures and materials with nodes for 3D scenes (three.js, Godot).

items.title: BeepBox
items.summary: Write chiptune music in the browser and export WAV or MP3 for the game's soundtrack.

items.title: pixelfx
items.summary: 244 pixel art effects and animations in code (fire, magic, hits, weather, UI), recolor and export sprite sheets for Phaser, Godot, Unity.

items.title: pixelfx skill
items.summary: Lets Claude Code find, tune, export and make new pixel effects with pixelfx.

items.title: Phaser
items.summary: A fast 2D game framework for the browser: scenes, physics, input, audio.

items.title: KAPLAY
items.summary: A friendly JavaScript game library: write a playable game in a few lines.

items.title: LittleJS
items.summary: A tiny, fast HTML5 game engine with particles, sound and tile layers built in.

items.title: PixiJS
items.summary: The fast 2D WebGL/WebGPU renderer behind many web games and interactive sites.

items.title: three.js
items.summary: 3D in the browser: scenes, models (GLB), lights and shaders.

items.title: howler.js
items.summary: Reliable audio for games and sites: sprites, looping, fades, spatial sound.

items.title: jsfxr
items.summary: Make retro sound effects (jumps, coins, hits) in the browser and export WAV, or generate them in code.

items.title: Piskel
items.summary: A free online editor for animated sprites and pixel art; export sprite sheets and GIFs.

items.title: LibreSprite
items.summary: A free desktop pixel art and animation editor (a fork of Aseprite's last open version).

items.title: Tiled
items.summary: The free tile map editor: levels, layers and objects, exported as JSON your game reads.

items.title: Astro
items.summary: Fast content sites and landing pages; ship zero JavaScript by default.

items.title: Vite
items.summary: The quick dev server and build tool for web apps, sites and browser games.

items.title: Tailwind CSS
items.summary: Style straight in your markup with utility classes; consistent spacing and color.

items.title: Lucide icons
items.summary: A clean, consistent open icon set (SVG), for sites and apps.

items.title: Tauri
items.summary: Small, fast desktop (and mobile) apps from a web front end. TribeCode's desktop app uses it.

items.title: Expo
items.summary: Build iPhone and Android apps with React Native, and try them on your phone instantly.

items.title: Capacitor
items.summary: Turn an existing web app into iPhone and Android apps, with native plugins for camera, files and more.

items.title: zx
items.summary: Write shell scripts in JavaScript: run commands, await them, pipe output.

items.title: Mermaid
items.summary: Diagrams and flowcharts from text, right inside Markdown notes.

items.title: Excalidraw
items.summary: A hand-drawn style whiteboard for sketching screens, maps and plans together.

items.title: Playwright MCP
items.summary: Lets Claude Code open your app in a real browser, click around and check it works.

items.title: Frontend design skill
items.summary: Helps Claude make distinctive, polished interfaces instead of generic ones.

items.title: Web app testing skill
items.summary: Claude tests your running web app with Playwright: screenshots, console logs, clicks.

items.title: Theme factory skill
items.summary: Ready color and type themes Claude can apply to a site, deck or app.

items.title: Algorithmic art skill
items.summary: Claude makes generative art with p5.js: backgrounds, title screens, textures.

items.title: MCP builder skill
items.summary: Claude builds an MCP server so agents can use your tool or API.

items.title: Skill creator
items.summary: Claude turns something your tribe does often into a reusable skill.

items.title: Doc co-authoring skill
items.summary: Claude co-writes docs and specs with you section by section.

items.title: Platformer skill
items.summary: Run, jump, coyote time, tiled levels, hazards and goals, with feel-tuning notes.

items.title: Game feel skill
items.summary: Screen shake, hit-stop, easing, squash and stretch: the juice that makes it feel good.

items.title: Level design skill
items.summary: Whitebox layouts, tile and grid structure, pacing.

items.title: Game AI skill
items.summary: State machines, behaviour trees, steering and pathfinding for NPCs and enemies.

items.title: Dialogue skill
items.summary: Branching dialogue and narrative (Yarn/Ink) for characters who talk.

items.title: Procedural generation skill
items.summary: Noise, seeds, dungeons and terrain generation.

items.title: Game assets skill
items.summary: Art direction and a pipeline for sprites, tiles, icons, UI art and 3D assets.

items.title: Camera skill
items.summary: 2D follow and bounds, 3D orbit and first-person cameras.

items.title: Save systems skill
items.summary: Save slots, versioning and autosave.

items.title: RPG skill
items.summary: Stats, levels, inventory, quests, dialogue, save and combat.

items.title: Phaser skill
items.summary: Phaser config, scenes, loader, cameras, and Arcade physics.

items.title: three.js scene skill
items.summary: Scene, camera, renderer, loop, resizing and controls.

items.title: three.js models skill
items.summary: Load glTF/GLB models and play their animations.

items.title: Prototype fast skill
items.summary: Greybox a playable slice and check it's fun before building more.

items.title: Game jam skill
items.summary: Scope, plan and ship a build under a time limit.

items.title: itch.io publish skill
items.summary: Make the itch.io page and upload builds with butler.
